delay_command_description: Schedule a message to be sent later, e.g. /delay 5m say hello
max_delay_days_description: The furthest into the future a message may be scheduled, in days (1-365). Invalid values fall back to 30.
list_snippet_length_description: How many characters of each scheduled message are shown in /delay list before truncation (20-500). Longer messages get a Show button. Invalid values fall back to 80.
remind_command_description: Set a personal reminder, e.g. /remind 20m say check the oven
allow_recurring_description: When off, /delay and /remind refuse "every ..." schedules. Existing repeats stop being armed.
max_recurring_per_user_description: How many active repeating schedules each user may have (1-100). Invalid values fall back to 10.
